source_note: Transcribed from local v5 catalogue; game rules and points not independently verified.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: When this unit makes ranged attacks against a Monster or Vehicle, it can re-roll Hit, Wound and Damage rolls.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: Once per battle per token, change one Hit roll or Wound roll for a non-Character model in the unit to an unmodified 6. One token per five models.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: Once per battle for each Aspect Shrine token this unit has, change one Hit roll or one Wound roll made for a model in this unit (excluding Character models) to an unmodified 6.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the target of that attack is the closest eligible target, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: At the start of the battle, select one of the following keywords: INFANTRY; MONSTER; MOUNTED; VEHICLE. Each time this model makes an attack that targets a unit with the selected keyword, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: While this model is within 12" of one or more friendly Aeldari Psyker models, improve the Ballistic Skill and Weapon Skill characteristics of weapons equipped by this model by 1 and it has a Leadership characteristic of 6+.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly AELDARI unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. Each unit can only be selected for this ability once per turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, this unit may make a Scout move of 9" when eligible. See the full Scouts core rule for transport and Strategic Reserve interactions.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: When deploying, this unit can be set up more than 8" horizontally from enemy units and the enemy deployment zone.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: If every model has Stealth, the unit receives the benefit of cover against ranged attacks.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: In the opponent’s Movement phase, after an enemy finishes a move within 8", this unit may make a Normal move of up to D6" if not engaged.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: Aeldari faction ability. Consult the current 11e Battle Focus rules for tokens and Agile Manoeuvres; this test does not encode token management.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: At the start of your Command phase, if this model is on the battlefield, you gain 1CP.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: At the end of your Movement phase, select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this model. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a friendly AELDARI model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: While this model is leading a unit, once per phase, you can change the result of one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll made for a model in that unit (excluding Support Weapon models) to an unmodified 6.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: At the end of your Movement phase, select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this model. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a friendly AELDARI model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll. Each unit can only be selected for this ability once per turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: While this model is leading a unit, once per phase, you can change the result of one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll made for a model in that unit to an unmodified 6.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: At the end of your Movement phase, select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this model. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Wound roll. Each unit can only be selected for this ability once per turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: Each time an attack is allocated to this model, halve the Damage characteristic of that attack.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: While a friendly AELDARI unit is within 6" of this model, add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for that unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the turn, each time a friendly model that disembarked from this TRANSPORT this turn makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: This unit can perform the Fade Back Agile Manoeuvre without spending a Battle Focus token to do so. It can do so even if other units have done so in the same phase, and doing so does not prevent other units from performing the same Agile Manoeuvre in the same phase.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: When the last Guardian Defender model in this unit is destroyed, any remaining Heavy Weapon Platform models in this unit are also destroyed.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: Each time this model makes a ranged attack that targets a unit that can FLY, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: Each time a ranged attack is allocated to a model, if that model is not fully visible to every model in the attacking unit because of this FORTIFICATION, that model has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: Each time a friendly AELDARI unit arrives from Strategic Reserves, you can choose to set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within 6" of this FORTIFICATION. If you do, that AELDARI unit can be set up within 9" of enemy models, and can be set up within Engagement Range of enemy models. If an AELDARI unit is set up within Engagement Range of any enemy models in this way, it counts as having made a Charge move this turn and is eligible to fight this turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: Each time an attack made with this model’s twin Scorpion pulsar destroys an enemy model that has the Deadly Demise ability, that model’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 4+ instead of on a 6.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.value: Each time a ranged attack targets this model, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of this model, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
